bbbp_inner_cv.acyclic_policy: each acyclic (empty Murcko scaffold) row is its own group
bbbp_inner_cv.algorithm: greedy stratified group assignment (least-loaded bottleneck scheduling): groups ordered by (-size, sha256(salt|scaffold)); each group goes to the fold minimising max((pos_f+p)/target_pos, (neg_f+n)/target_neg), ties -> lowest fold index; no RNG

label_scope: Lipophilicity target summaries are computed from the published CSV labels for *structure statistics only*; no model is fitted here and no Test metric is computed. BBBP fold construction uses Train labels only and ignores Validation/Test entirely.
